label: PF Backlog 706
title: Prospective Memory Engine: tracking deferred actions, future stage obligations, scheduled triggers, and cross-stage handoff notes
body:
## Problem / why
Agents lose track of deferred obligations, follow-up commitments, and cross-stage handoff notes across restarts.

## Goal & value
Deliver the Prospective Memory engine to track deferred actions, trigger conditions, and cross-stage obligations so agents never drop commitments.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-5.6`
- `docs/RAG-PROCESS-MEMORY.md#section-9`

## In scope
- Prospective obligation schema (action, trigger_condition, target_stage, status, priority).
- Trigger evaluation engine firing on workflow state transitions or gate take-ups.
- Cross-stage handoff compiler re-injecting pending commitments at the next stage start.

## Out of scope
- Unchecked background daemon execution without workflow orchestration.

## Definition of Done
- End-to-end stage handoff test verifies prospective obligations persist and trigger across runs.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
